blockers.title: A student heading that carries an age is now a student row with no mark. 'Allievi Deriva 12/14 anni' becomes the READY student 'Deriva Allievi, 14'. Both 5c1e029 and the round-9 tree dropped it
blockers.scenario: Probes round10/r10b, r10c, r10d (laid-out TSV) and r10f, with fake date 2026-09-27 and course start 2026-08-29. Sheet: 'ELENCO PARTECIPANTI', 'Allievi Deriva 12/14 anni', the column header, four students. Current output: 'Allievi|Deriva|14|none|READY' before the students. 5c1e029 dropped the line as a student heading, and so did the round-9 tree (F1R9-4 describes it dropping every student-word line). The same happens when the range is written with an em dash, a tilde, 'e' or '÷', or when OCR loses the hyphen ('12 14 anni'), in brackets or after a colon. It also happens with 'Partecipanti Vela 10—12 anni', 'Studenti Deriva 12—14 anni', 'Allieve Deriva …' and 'Allievi Barca/Squadra …'. Single ages do it too: 'Allievi Deriva 12 anni', 'Allievi Vela 12 anni', 'Allievi Scuola 12 anni', 'Allievi fino a 14 anni', 'Allievi (età minima 10 anni)', 'Allievi minimo 8 anni', 'ALLIEVI DERIVA 12 ANNI'. It happens at the top, under the title, and between groups ('Allievi Catamarano 14/16 anni' between students), on both text and table paths. Mechanism: the F1R9-4 fix (readsAsPersonLine inside studentWordLine) turns any student-word line with a plausible age into a row. classifyLine's possible-heading mark covers only NON_STUDENT_LINE_PATTERN words, so 'Corso Deriva 12/14 anni' is marked while 'Allievi Deriva 12/14 anni' is not. AGE_RANGE_PATTERN accepts only '-' and '–'. The row is READY when the second word gives a sex (Deriva, Vela, Scuola, Barca …); 'Allievi Optimist/Laser/Junior …' need review. 'Aggiungi N allievi' then saves the heading as a student with no tap on that row. 'Iscritti/Corsisti Deriva 12—14 anni' give the same result as 5c1e029, which did not know those words. Next steps (1_0_0_NEXT_STEPS.md:109-122) says such a line is not a student heading, but not that it is kept as a student that can be ready. Realism: this needs a section or group heading with a student word and an age on the sheet. The synthetic layout has none, and the private rosters were not inspected. The literal outcome is the blocker class, and there is no earlier same-scenario rating to follow.
blockers.suggestedFix: When a line has a student word in its leading text and no staff word, and studentWordLine returns null only because readsAsPersonLine is true, keep the row but mark it possible-heading, as heading words already are. 'Corsisti Marco 12/03/2014 12 anni' is still kept, but marked. Optionally extend AGE_RANGE_PATTERN to '—', '/', '~' and a missing separator. Add a test with 'Allievi Deriva 12/14 anni' at the top and between students, and describe the rule in next steps.

importantFindings.title: A student heading that ends in a number or carries a staff word no longer arms a label or contact line at the top. Role-less staff rows under it are READY with no mark. 5c1e029 dropped them, and the round-9 tree marked them
importantFindings.location: src/capabilities/studentScan.ts:1007-1017 (the closing-number test at :1016 and the whole-line staff test), 1228-1232, 1246-1262
importantFindings.scenario: Probes round10/r10a group B, r10d (TSV) and r10e group M. The top line is 'Nome assistente:', or one of 'Cognome Nome Nascita Assistente' under 'Corso Deriva 2', 'Firma istruttrice', 'Personale tel. 3331234567' or 'Segreteria 0789 123456'. Below it: 'Verdani Luca 03/04/1990 36 anni' and 'Galli Sara 05/05/1995 31 anni' (or ages only), then a student heading, then the students. With 'Allievi' the staff rows are possible-staff (the F1R9-1 fix works). The staff rows are 'none|READY' in text and in laid-out tables with 15 of 17 numbered headings, including 'Allievi turno 2', 'Iscritti Corso Deriva 2', 'Elenco iscritti pag. 1', 'Allievi - Gruppo 3', 'Partecipanti settimana 1', 'ELENCO PARTECIPANTI 2026', 'Iscritti turno 1', 'Allievi gruppo 1', 'Iscritti: 12', 'Allievi pag. 1/2' and 'Corsisti turno 3'. The two exceptions are 'Allievi (turno 2)' and 'Allievi turno II'. The cause: studentWordLine calls each of these a 'count', and studentHeadingFollows accepts only a 'heading'. The same happens with a student table header that has a staff column ('Allievi Nascita Istruttore', 'Allievo Data di nascita Assistente') and with a group heading that names the instructor ('ALLIEVI - Istruttore Verdani'), because a staff word anywhere in the line now wins. In those cases the students after it are also marked possible-staff. The round-9 tree read all of these lines as student headings. The literal outcome is the blocker class. It is rated important because it is the scenario of F1R9-1, F1R8-2 and F1R8-5 with a different heading, and rounds 8 and 9 rated that scenario important. It also needs role-less staff printed with a birth date or age between the top line and the heading. Next steps accurately says a student heading has 'no closing number' and no staff word, but not that the staff above such a heading stay ready.
importantFindings.suggestedFix: For studentHeadingFollows only, accept any student-word line, count or heading, that is followed by a row that reads as a student. A footer count has nothing after it, so F1R9-3(a) stays fixed. Keep the current count rule for ending the marking. Let a staff word win on a mixed line only when it is a collective word or the line has no label word. Add tests for 'Nome assistente:' above 'Allievi turno 2' and 'ELENCO PARTECIPANTI 2026'.

qolFindings.title: A student-word footer with no number still makes the contact line or table header at the top mark every student
qolFindings.scenario: Probe r10e group N. The top line is 'Segreteria 0789 123456' or 'Cognome Nome Nascita Istruttore', then four students, then one of these footers: 'Firma allievi', 'Allievi assenti:', 'Note per gli allievi', 'Firma degli allievi ________' or 'Allievi presenti: ____'. Every student becomes possible-staff|review, one tap each. Without the top line, all four are READY. F1R9-3(a) fixed this only for a count footer. SC-11 says 'so the school’s contact line and the table header above the students mark nothing', which does not hold on these sheets. This is noise only.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Apply the lookahead rule from F1R10-2: only a student-word line followed by a row that reads as a student counts as the heading. Otherwise, qualify SC-11.
